rulings.why: The page cannot tell these changes from the row: join:refrain.1.2: End of 454-strip0.jpg system 2 into system 3 (454-strip800.jpg), the refrain's row: line 3's first word is printed with a capital right after a question mark, a capital it takes anyway; the refrain has one row and no metre is printed (454-strip0.jpg header), so nothing tells the joined line apart. moveup:refrain.1.2: 454-strip800.jpg system 3, the refrain's row: the moved word follows a question mark and the word after it is the always-capitalised interjection after an exclamation mark, so both carry capitals anyway; with no metre printed, nothing shows which of the two opens line 3.
